name: CAIO AI-Readiness Assessment
description: Pre-sign go/no-go qualification gate for a Chief-AI-Officer engagement — the whitepaper's honest 30-minute discovery call. Maps a company against a 9-dimension AI-Readiness Maturity Model (Leadership & sponsorship / Tooling & API-exposure / Strategy & use-case clarity / Data readiness / Governance, risk & compliance / Culture & change-appetite / Talent & AI-literacy / Infrastructure / Budget & commitment) scored 0-4 with evidence, computes a weighted Readiness Index /100 + maturity tier (Nascent/Emerging/Ready/Leading), and returns an honest GO / NOT-YET / REDIRECT verdict with hard gates and a feel-felt-found objection bank. On GO it shapes the engagement (which of the 5 phases, 1-3 months, member count) + indicative investment from the real grid (EUR 2,500 setup + EUR 2,500/member/month, monthly no-minimum) and hands to /market-proposal for the signed SOW. Stays at qualification altitude — defers all detailed technical mapping to E2 (caio-enterprise-workflow-architect). Doctrine: mm-10 selling (primary), mm-03 JTBD/4-forces, mm-02 positioning, mm-01 2026 window. Writes caio-readiness/.
author: Agentik OS
